candidates: When calling `api.setAddonShortcut`, every registration must use a unique `actionName`; reusing an existing `actionName` silently overrides the previously registered shortcut instead of adding a second binding. If a logical action needs multiple keyboard shortcuts (e.g., two different keys that both zoom in), use distinct `actionName` values (e.g., `zoomIn` and `zoomInAlt`) — be aware that each will appear as a separate, independent entry in the keyboard shortcuts configuration table.
